skill_name: Identify the emotions in the given speech and explain why they are used.
workflow: The speech conveys two main emotions - joy and pride. The speaker expresses joy in remembering the results of the victory, which indicates a positive emotion. The speaker also conveys a sense of pride in having achieved a victory, which is a feeling of satisfaction. Both emotions are used to emphasize the importance of the victory and the joy the speaker felt when hearing the results.
